title: Batch optimizer dispatch accepts array of scores

comments.author: derek
comments.text:
Feature: Batch Optimizer Dispatch
  Scenario: Dispatch optimizers for multiple scores
    Given a scorecard with 13 scores under 90% accuracy
    When I call plexus.procedure.optimize_batch with scorecard and array of score names
    Then all 13 optimizer procedures are dispatched asynchronously
    And I receive an array of procedure_id values
    And I can check status of all procedures with plexus.procedure.status_batch
